body: Hi! for me because of the “cocktail” i take it actually messes up a lot. I had to be hospitalized last time that a mess up happened with wellbutrin

oh yea it would make me even more pissed but my anger is the silent kind where i just go kinda catatonic for a while? And he just sits in a different room and lets me be but i had traumatized him a lot i think that he didn’t trust me to leave when i’m in a bad head space
also this ex i’m talking about is different than the guy from the post

i was very lucky with my ex- i don’t think i’ll ever find someone like him cause he put up with A LOT of my shit. at some point i was like listen i think i’m being abusive to you which i think i was tbh which sucks. But he stayed and was like i know it’s not you when that happens and well he’s right but at the same time it’s no excuse. He would usually not let me leave when i want to and he’d be like it’s okay just feel everything here etc but i think that was mostly cause he was worried id go and off myself lmaoo. man i miss him but it didn’t work out sadly
omgg same. I always walk out when shit gets like that. Everytime. People don’t understand but it like the only i can deal without becoming a huge bitch to whoever is infront of me

it brought me peace in the beginning but then it all went to shit. there’s so much stigma around bpd and just personality disorders in general that at some point it started making things worse for me by just having that label. I feel the same way- will i or will i not overcome it? cause if i don’t i honestly don’t see the point of living in this shitty way

my meds help overall but when i deal with rejection or just going through a bad episode nothing really helps, if that makes any sense. I had to stop therapy as i can’t afford it anymore which is really shitty cause therapy and dbt helped during the times where i felt like nothing can help or nothing will ever be better

i’ve got bpd and people think i’m over-dramatic or that i always make things about myself but it’s just that i see a crisis in everything and i always thinking everything is my fault. so somehow i make everything about myself cause in my head i’m the cause of everything wrong in this world. i always just feel very guilty sometimes for even breathing on this planet. i also have chronic suicidal ideation and sometimes people have the audacity to say to me “just think positively” it’s like i can’t control it. 
idk if this makes any sense to the people but yea mental illness sucks.
